paragraphs: I'm applying for the Information Security Analyst role at Boot Barn's Irvine headquarters. I want to start my security career on a team where one analyst works across access control, data protection, network security and user training, and this role covers all of that. I'm local to Irvine/Orange County, and I finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine with a specialization in Networked Systems.

My networking coursework covered TCP/IP, the OSI model, DNS and TLS. In labs I used Wireshark to capture and analyze traffic and Burp Suite to study attacks like MITM, ARP poisoning and SQL injection. I've also secured a live system. I built and operate CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app on the App Store, and I own how its user data is protected. I wrote role-based access-control rules that restrict access to sensitive data and block IDOR and privilege escalation, with 36 adversarial unit tests to check them. I added multi-provider authentication, full account and data deletion, and scheduled data-retention cleanup, and I keep every credential and secret out of version control.

I haven't run vulnerability scanners or SIEM tools on the job yet, and I'm eager to learn your stack. I'm studying for the CompTIA Security+ exam in January. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, and as a certified crew trainer at Raising Cane's, I've learned to teach standards clearly, which helps with security awareness training.
I'd welcome the chance to help protect Boot Barn's networks and data, and I'm happy to talk about timing.
